name: inplace
description: Monorepo for the Inplace visual copy editor and its demo site.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/inplace && npm run build -w inplace-demo && npm run build -w inplace-demo-astro
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @thereactnativerewind/inplace && npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/inplace && npm run typecheck -w inplace-demo
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/inplace && npm run migrate -w @thereactnativerewind/inplace
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @thereactnativerewind/inplace && npm run dev -w inplace-demo
